title: Quantifying Water Transit Time Distributions for Two Artificial Hillslopes During a Summer Season: Combining StorAge Selection Functions and Non‐parametric Identification in Flow‐Weighted Time
content:
Abstract

Understanding and quantifying water transit time distributions (TTDs) is critical for characterizing water storage, flow paths, and solute transport under hydrologic variability. This study investigates hillslope-scale TTDs using non-parametric identification in flow-weighted time (FWT), including time-averaged (TA), two-state (TS), and state-dependent (SDP) multiple linear regression models, as well as using StorAge Selection (SAS) functions. SAS functions model the time-variant TTDs based on age-ranked water storage, while non-parametric methods are applied in FWT to minimize external variability and capture internal transport processes. TA models assume static TTDs, TS models capture TTD variability between wet and dry conditions, while SDP models dynamically adjust TTDs with storage states. We applied these methods to data collected at two artificial hillslopes at the Landscape Evolution Observatory, Biosphere 2, during a summer rainfall experiment. The results highlight that the SAS function model produced smoother discharge deuterium signals and captured seasonal behavior. In contrast, non-parametric flow weighted time methods were more sensitive to transient transport responses. Among them, SDP models yield more continuous TTDs and outperform TA and TS models in fitting discharge concentrations. Event scale results showed a transition from filling to memory and flushing, reflecting changes in storage connectivity. The West hillslope, although more homogeneous, showed stronger sensitivity to storage changes, while the East hillslope showed greater within event variability associated with subsurface heterogeneity. These results show that flow weighted time methods can recover dynamic transit time behavior from measured tracer data and identify how storage and heterogeneity shape hillslope transport.
